= Journal 2026-06-13 =

== FZF with PowerShell ==
:fzf:ripgrep:bat:fd:powershell:

- [[/diary/2026-03-29#FZF with PowerShell]]
- [[https://www.powershellgallery.com/packages/PSFzf|PSGallery / PSFzf]] is a PowerShell wrapper for `fzf`.
  - [[https://github.com/kelleyma49/PSFzf|kelleyma49 PSFzf]]
  - [[https://github.com/kelleyma49/PSFzf#helper-functions|Helper Functions]]

{{{powershell
# replace 'Ctrl+t' and 'Ctrl+r' with your preferred bindings:
Set-PsFzfOption `
  -PSReadlineChordProvider 'Ctrl+t' `
  -PSReadlineChordReverseHistory 'Ctrl+r'

Set-PSReadLineKeyHandler `
  -Key Tab `
  -ScriptBlock { Invoke-FzfTabCompletion }
Set-PsFzfOption -TabExpansion
}}}

- PSReadline History (default chord: `Alt+a`)
- Selected Directory (default chord: `Alt+c`)
- `Ctrl+/` is broken per
  [[https://github.com/kelleyma49/PSFzf/issues/380|Preview fails with Go 'fork/exec invalid argument' error #380]].
- EnableFd prepends the current directory to absolute paths.
